title: Weight calculation sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 41 (Weight calculation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 41: Forces and their effects; weight and mass. To understand what forces do and the difference between mass and weight

model.title: A bag of rice has a mass of 2 kg. What is its weight on Earth?

questions.q: A 3 kg bag on the Moon (g = 1.6 N/kg). Weight?
questions.model: Weight = mass × g. On the Moon g = 1.6. 3 × 1.6 = 4.8. So 4.8 N.

questions.q: Is gravity a contact or non-contact force?
Does mass change on the Moon?
Weigh three items at home with kitchen scales (grams). Convert to kg and calculate each weight in N.
questions.a: For example: 500 g rice = 0.5 kg = 5 N; 1 kg flour = 10 N; 250 g butter = 2.5 N
questions.model: Teacher does the first: 500 g = 0.5 kg; 0.5 × 10 = 5 N.

questions.q: Draw force arrows on a book resting on a table and label them.
questions.a: Weight down (gravity), equal reaction force up from the table

questions.q: Why do kitchen scales show grams, not newtons?
questions.a: They measure the push of weight but are set to show mass, assuming Earth's g.

questions.q: Big question: how can the astronaut's mass stay the same but weight change?
questions.a: Mass is the matter; weight depends on gravity, which is weaker on the Moon.
